newsitem.title: USA: U.S Treasury developing possible Fed nominees list.
newsitem.headline: U.S Treasury developing possible Fed nominees list.

text.p: The Treasury Department is working on a list of potential nominees to the Federal Reserve Board, U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin said on Monday.
"We are developing a list of names and will then bring our list to the (White House's) National Economic Council table," he said. "And in time we'll have recommendations for the president."
Some analysts have accused the administration in the past of taking too long to come up with nominees for the Fed board, leaving positions open for months at a time.
Asked about this, Rubin said, "in the past we have been very thoughtful and we will continue to be very thoughtful."
Janet Yellen and Lawrence Lindsey have recently announced they intend to leave the Fed board.
